[[Ascalon Academy]] | map = [[File:The Path to Glory map.png|250px]] | map1text = [[Sir Tydus]] stands only a few paces from [[Armin Saberlin]]. | experience reward = 100 | completion reward = 100g ({{reforgedmode}} only) }} With a second profession under your belt, you are ready to head off to war against the [[Charr]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | test = y | complete = [[A Second Profession]] }} ===Objectives=== * Go to [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]] to speak to [[Sir Tydus]]. ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) ==Walkthrough== Sir Tydus is only a few steps to the left from the quest giver. Simply walk over and speak to him to complete the objective. '''Caution:''' The follow-up mini-mission initiates [[the Searing]], an irreversible point of no return for your character. You can safely claim this quest's reward, but do not accept the next one from Sir Tydus until you are absolutely ready to leave [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]] behind. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Armin Saberlin :''"You look ready for war, . Ready as any of us are the first time, at any rate. That's good. From what I've seen, the war party will be prepared to head out soon. You'd best go talk to '''Sir Tydus''' lest they set forth without you."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'm on my way. | decline = I'm not ready yet. | ask = Why are you back here talking to me? '''Sir Tydus''' is right over there! }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Sir Tydus :''"Have you heard? We're almost ready to set out. Before you join us, keep in mind that you'll have to say goodbye to all of the comforts of Ascalon City. Out there beyond [[Great Northern Wall|the Wall]] our lives will be in constant danger, and we'll have only our comrades to rely on. But [[Balthazar]] willing, we'll drive these Charr from our kingdom once and for all."'' {{Pre-Searing Quest nav}}
